description: The chart represents the win rate percentages of different models, comparing their relative proportions. The pie chart is divided into four slices, representing the models GPT-4o, Mistral, LLaMA, and an unlabeled gray slice. The GPT-4o slice is the largest, colored blue, and accounts for approximately 98.4% of the chart. The Mistral slice is smaller, also blue, and represents around 1.2%. The LLaMA slice is the second smallest, colored light blue, and makes up about 3.2%. The gray slice is the smallest and is not labeled. The chart includes percentage labels outside the slices, connected by lines to their corresponding sections, and the labels are positioned outside the chart. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with GPT-4o being the largest and the gray slice being the smallest.
